narr: Before diving into the specifics, let's consider what digital organization means and why it matters.
Digital organization isn't just about having a clean desktop - it's about creating systems that help us work more efficiently and reduce cognitive load.
When our digital spaces are organized, we can find what we need quickly, focus better on important tasks, and feel more in control of our digital environments.
